crime: Every afternoon, {WITCH_NAME}'s regular reading partner chose an ordinary library book and asked her to read it aloud. The partner enjoyed listening, and {WITCH_NAME} always agreed. Sitting together gave her company without requiring her to choose anything herself.

One afternoon, the partner placed two books before {WITCH_NAME} and asked which one they should read. {WITCH_NAME} stared at them without answering. After waiting, the partner took both books away and said that unless she chose for herself, the partner would read with someone else starting the next day.

Shortly before evening free time ended, the partner's roommate stopped at the library and saw the partner alive. The roommate then went to the nearby recreation room, retrieved a sweater, put it on there, and returned a few minutes later.

The roommate found the partner strangled inside the library, with no one else there. The strangled woman's regular reading companion wore an assigned uniform with a distinctive cuff. A fresh strip torn from that cuff was caught under the dead partner's fingernails. Yet the roommate remembered passing no one at the doorway or in the hall.

A button from the same cuff, still trailing freshly torn thread, was caught in the collar of the sweater the roommate had just put on. The matching cuff on the reading companion's uniform had a fresh tear and was missing both that button and the strip of fabric.

Because the roommate put on the sweater only after seeing the partner alive, the button in its collar proved that {WITCH_NAME} had crossed paths with the roommate on the return trip. The fabric under the partner's fingernails linked {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive cuff to the fatal struggle, while the roommate's missing memory showed that their encounter had been erased. {WITCH_NAME} had strangled the partner, whose fingernails tore {WITCH_NAME}'s cuff, then brushed against the new sweater as the roommate returned and made the roommate forget seeing her at the doorway, never noticing the loose button caught in the collar.
fields.epitaph: At last, her silence was answered for her.
execution: A giant iron mouth opens wide, surrounding her as she stands, and orders her to say no.
She parts her lips, but no answer comes. The iron jaws begin closing without waiting.
The jaws clamp her head and torso and pin both arms against her sides. They press inward until her skull, ribs, and spine break between them. The mouth keeps closing until her chest no longer moves.

magic.name: the Missing Memory
magic.text: She can make someone forget an encounter with her.
